topics.topic: Required atomicity and cleanup when returning UNSAFE_REFERENCE
questions: Before returning UNSAFE_REFERENCE, must store_image leave the binary store completely unchanged, or may it create or leave temporary files or directories so long as the final image is not written?

quotes: A `DelivererError` with the UNSAFE_REFERENCE member of `RefusalCode` when the reference leaves the binary store or a link in the store cannot be resolved, before the image is written (A6 rule 1); `module:photo_delivery` passes it on as M08. A failed write raises the operating system error, which `module:photo_delivery` turns into the failure of that photo.

When it does not, or when a link in the store cannot be resolved,
   the delivery is refused as a whole with the UNSAFE_REFERENCE member of = models.RefusalCode, an M08
   and not a failed photo, and no stored image and no record is written.

The installation creates the binary
   store and the state folder; the service creates only folders below them, with the imported
   `STORE_FOLDER_MODE` and `STATE_FOLDER_MODE` constants, and removes none.

A write cut short by a
   crash leaves at most a temporary file whose name begins with the imported `TEMPORARY_NAME_PREFIX`
   constant, which is never read.
A failed atomic write removes its temporary file, unless that removal fails too; the temporary file then stays, as A6 rule 3 decides.
judgement.divergence: One implementation performs containment and link resolution before creating anything, so UNSAFE_REFERENCE leaves the binary store unchanged; another creates folders or a temporary file first and leaves them behind when it refuses, which the owner or a later store operation notices.
judgement.why: The texts prohibit a stored image and record on this refusal but do not decide whether ancillary folders or temporary files may be created and remain before UNSAFE_REFERENCE is returned.

witness.initial: The binary store contains a folder link on the destination path that cannot be resolved, and the destination has no stored image or record.
events: `module:photo_delivery` calls `delivery_store.store_image` with image bytes for the project and source.
One implementation resolves the destination before creating folders or a temporary file and returns UNSAFE_REFERENCE.
Another implementation creates an ancillary folder or temporary file before completing resolution, then returns UNSAFE_REFERENCE without removing that artifact.
outcomes: UNSAFE_REFERENCE is returned and the binary store is otherwise unchanged.
UNSAFE_REFERENCE is returned and an ancillary folder or temporary file remains in the binary store.
witness.observer: The owner or a later store operation inspecting the binary store.
basis: The context of the operations, the project id, the source id and the image bytes.
8. `capability:delivery_store.store_image` writes the image and returns its reference.

A name built that way cannot
   leave the store, so the refusal is reachable only when a folder of the store is a link that leads out
   of it or that cannot be resolved, such as a loop of links.

The installation creates the binary
   store and the state folder; the service creates only folders below them, with the imported
   `STORE_FOLDER_MODE` and `STATE_FOLDER_MODE` constants, and removes none.

topics.topic: Whether unsafe-link checks include a symlink at the destination file itself
questions: Does this include the destination file itself when it is a dangling or looping symbolic link, or only folder links on the path to the destination?

quotes:
A name built that way cannot
   leave the store, so the refusal is reachable only when a folder of the store is a link that leads out
   of it or that cannot be resolved, such as a loop of links.
judgement.why: The text expressly limits this refusal to an unsafe or unresolvable folder link, so an existing symbolic link at the destination file itself is not included.
